title: File:Abandoned gasoline price board in Büren.jpg
desc: Rusty price display of a former gas station on the Mauritiusstraße street in Büren (Westphalia), Germany. In the background, the road leading up to the Kapellenberg hill can be seen.

title: File:Station Total Energies à casablanca lors du blocage du détroit d'Ormuz en Iran-photo Bertrand SOUBEYRAND.jpg
desc: A TotalEnergies petrol station in Casablanca, Morocco, on 10/05/2026, during the blockade of the Strait of Hormuz by Iran and the United States. The price board shows diesel at 14.53 dirhams and unleaded petrol at 14.52 dirhams per litre.
